verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships its own event-driven automation. Triggers fire actions on regex matches without user input, such as running commands, auto-responding to prompts, sending notifications or invoking Python scripts. Python and AppleScript APIs plus an AutoLaunch script that runs on startup round this out, and long-lived session servers keep shells running in the background. However, these automations are tied to the running terminal app and are scripted rather than agentic; the AI chat only runs commands on the user's behalf within an interactive session. Missing for 10: scheduled or unattended background jobs independent of the open app, autonomous AI-agent automations, hands-on corroboration of background automation workflows.
